user.title: Add a LYWSD02 / LYWSD02MMC
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Xiaomi LYWSD02 or LYWSD02MMC thermo-hygrometer. This adds a "Sync time" button for it; the lywsd02.set_time service keeps working on its own regardless.
